notes.title: Update - 1.1.8 - Steam Autumn Sale
notes.content:
Nerfing ALL the enemies!!

[list]
[*] -5% HP
[*] -5% Damage
[*] -5% Move Speed
[*] -5% Attack Speed
[/list]

notes.title: Updates 1.1.7 - Fixing bugs and nerfing PC
notes.content:
Fixed a text bug that was causing the game to crash.

The unlock progression screen had no text in the Portuguese version.

Played runs were not being counted.

Nerf:
PC's speed was reduced from 113 to 109.
[img]https://media1.tenor.com/m/ONSdvZesyewAAAAC/rage-computer.gif[/img]

notes.title: Update - 1.1.6
notes.content: Fixing a bug where difficulty modifiers weren't affecting bosses.

notes.title: Updates - 1.1.5 - Sound Hotfix
notes.content: Fixed a bug where some sounds wouldn't play when too many things happened at once.

notes.title: Update - 1.1.5
notes.content:
Bug Fix:
Fixed a rare bug that caused the game to freeze during the boss fight.

Gameplay change: 
Hearts are no longer destroyed when the player changes rooms.

[img]https://media1.tenor.com/m/fv3JzoFdPBYAAAAC/cat.gif[/img]

notes.title: Updates - 1.1.4

notes.title: Update 1.1.3 - Hotfix
notes.content: Fixed a bug in the portal's particle generator.

notes.title: Update 1.1.3 - Improving performance and fixing bugs 🐞
notes.content:
Improving game performance
Fixing a series of bugs that were causing the game to crash

notes.title: Update 1.1.1 – NERFING WTF BOSS
notes.content:
Wtf Boss
[list]
[*]Reduced HP from 7,250 to 7,000.
[*]Reduced projectile damage from 25 to 20.
[*]Reduced projectile velocity from 115 to 113.
[*]Reduced movement speed from 94 to 92.
[*]Reduced punch charge speed from 113 to 105.
[*]Increased attack delay after teleport from 0.54 (Rage mode: 0.48) to 0.58 (Rage mode: 0.53).
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.1.0 – Minor Update
notes.content:
Fixed various bugs
Added partial controller support

notes.title: HOTFIX
notes.content: Bug fixed: game over cutscene was looping infinitely.

notes.title: DEMO UPDATE - BALANCING THINGS
notes.content:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45231366/408ddb1734816cb9350c63f50c7cf2234fa9d8dd.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45231366/408ddb1734816cb9350c63f50c7cf2234fa9d8dd.gif[/img][/url]

Helloooooooooo🔫🤨

Today, I bring you some new and interesting updates!

Updated:
[list]
[*] Reduced stamina consumption.
[*] Increased attack cooldown for ranged enemies.
[*] Increased trigger delay for arrow traps.
Reduced damage from all traps.
[/list]

Added:
[list]
[*] New animation for ranged enemies.
[*] New stomp effect for melee enemies.
[/list]

notes.title: NEW DEMO UPDATE
